id.title: Id
id.description: Role id. A string so large ids survive JSON parsing.

color.title: Color
color.description: Role colour as an integer, 0 when the role has no colour set.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the role sits in the guild's role list. Higher is further up.

managed.title: Managed
managed.description: True when Discord or an integration owns the role and nobody can assign it by hand.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Every role the member holds, apart from @everyone.

429.description: Out of requests. `X-RateLimit-Bucket` says which limit you hit and `Retry-After` how many seconds to wait. This request was not counted against you.

X-RateLimit-Tier.description: Plan your limits were taken from.

X-RateLimit-Bucket.description: The limit the other headers describe, the one closest to running out.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of when that window resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

detail.title: Detail
detail.default: You have used your 5 requests per 1 second (burst limit, free plan). Try again in 1s.
